files.caption: Front Street in Downtown Traverse City is a charming and vibrant commercial drag that is the symbolic and commercial heart of the Grand Traverse Bay region. Developed initially during the 19th Century, today the street is lined with interesting shops, good restaurants, and commercial enterprises that make Traverse City a popular and fun tourist destination for people from all around the United States. Though less well-known than other tourist hubs, Traverse City is worthy of visiting if you like
